findings.text: The company's status is recorded as 'active' with the detail 'active-proposal-to-strike-off'.
The company was incorporated on 2 September 2015, making it 11.1 years old.
The accounts are overdue; the next accounts were due 30 June 2023 and the last accounts were made up to 30 September 2021.
The confirmation statement is overdue; the next statement was due 15 September 2022 and the last was made up to 1 September 2021.
There are 2 current officers, both directors: PERSON 334 (appointed 11 April 2022) and PERSON 335 (appointed 2 September 2015).
One person with significant control is recorded: PERSON 338, an individual holding 25 to 50 percent of the shares.
No charges are registered against the company, and Companies House holds no insolvency record for it.
No registered office address changes or officer appointments or resignations have been filed since 24 October 2025.

headline.text: TEST COMPANY 456 is active but has a proposal to be struck off, with overdue accounts and an overdue confirmation statement on the Companies House record.
